crossRefs.note: When Herod had sought for him, and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to…

translations.web: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”
translations.bsb: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
translations.kjv: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
translations.asv: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and rid you of care.
